comment: Branched exits (roadmap F4b) with a temporary branch that only exists in this test: Hyrule Castle may lead to the Castle Basement (stairs down) or to the Catacombs, which stand in for a variant of chapter 2 and are reached by the stairs up. More two-exit levels than the real weights. Contact sheet of seeds that show each case (5: one exit; 3: two exits on opposite sides; 6: extra exit in a secret room; 8: stairs up and a secret extra exit), then Link takes the extra exit of seed 8 and, on a new build, the main exit, through the rest stop before the Catacombs. The 'exits' log lines say where each exit is and leads.
name: branch_exits
